tags.title: Tags
tags.description: One or more tags to match, semicolon-separated for AND logic, e.g. "rust;async" (must have both tags). Use exact Stack Exchange tag spelling, e.g. "docker" not "Docker".

site.title: Site
site.description: Stack Exchange site to search, by subdomain, e.g. "stackoverflow", "serverfault", "askubuntu", "dba", "superuser".

unansweredOnly.title: Unanswered only
unansweredOnly.description: Only return questions with zero answers so far.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by question creation date.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of questions to return, most recent first.
